item.title: Reflecting on Benji
item.description: Its been almost a year since Benji was taken from us. I’ve had almost a year to reflect on the events that occurred last August, and I’ve decided maybe writing out some thoughts on the process would help. Continued on 8/11/26 Last year I started writing this and couldn’t really bring myself to finish it, or even really put much down to start with. I was thinking about this post again last night and noticed a shift in my thoughts since starting around this time last year.
